history.summary: A 420 sqft freehold shoebox in Lorong 25A Geylang (D14) asking $1,726 psf - which is ABOVE the project's recent transactions, so the dossier's 'cheap' label is a thin-cohort quirk, not a bargain.
history.rating_rationale: The web checks invert the dossier's value story: EdgeProp shows Centra Suites' last-12-month sales at ~$1,592 psf with a Jan-2024 high of $1,672 psf for a 420-sqft unit (exactly this size), yet this listing asks $1,726 psf - i.e. ABOVE realized recent transactions. The dossier's -8.2% age_adj_premium and +9.1% cohort premium rest on only 11 cohort txns in a tiny 62-unit boutique block, so the 'cheap' signal is statistical noise, not verified value. v3.4 explicitly warns freehold is not a forward edge and to be skeptical of thin cohorts. Geylang freehold projects have a documented record of more unprofitable than profitable resales, and a 62-unit no-facilities block (gym/jacuzzi/parking only) has weak resale liquidity and stigma drag. The ~4.6% project yield is the one positive, but it does not offset paying above-market on a thin-data, low-liquidity asset.
red_flags: Asking $1,726 psf is ABOVE verified recent transactions (~$1,592-$1,672 psf) - not cheap
'Cheap' age_adj signal rests on only 11 cohort txns in a 62-unit boutique block (data quirk)
Geylang freehold has a documented pattern of more unprofitable than profitable resales
62-unit no-frills development (gym/jacuzzi/parking only) = weak resale liquidity; Geylang locale stigma
catalysts: Freehold tenure (but v3.4: not a forward edge)
~4.6% project rental yield, supported by Aljunied/Dakota MRT access and rental demand
